description: This file manages shell completion setup and maintenance for the openclaw CLI, including generating completion caches, checking status, and prompting user interaction for installation or upgrades.

methods.name: generateCompletionCache
methods.description: Generates the shell completion cache by spawning the CLI process.

methods.name: checkShellCompletionStatus
methods.description: Checks the current status of shell completion, including profile installation, cache existence, and pattern usage.

methods.name: doctorShellCompletion
methods.description: Performs a doctor check for shell completion, upgrading or installing as needed, with user prompts.

methods.name: ensureCompletionCacheExists
methods.description: Ensures the completion cache exists, regenerating it if missing, used during setup or update.
